description: PUB, Singapore's national water agency, publishes catchment maps that qualified persons (architects and engineers) must use in development control submissions. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists the drainage catchment map, the drainage boundary map and sewerage catchment maps for the island's sewerage areas, such as Jurong, Kranji and Pandan, offered as downloadable map files. Coverage is national, since Singapore's drainage and used-water networks cover the whole island. Access is free; no licence is stated, and the maps are provided for regulatory submissions. Caveats: the maps are drawings for development control, not GIS layers with attributes, catchment boundaries may be revised as the network changes, and the drain and sewer networks themselves are not included. It supports flood exposure and drainage network studies, for instance assigning buildings and roads to the drainage catchments and sewerage areas that serve them. Related records: data-singapore-pub-drain-water-level-sensors-flood-alerts gives PUB's real-time drain water levels.
